appDesc.message: Ask Sara about the page you are on, save it to her Library, or let her fill a form after you approve it.

pairIntro.message: Connect this browser to your Sara. Type her address; she shows a short code you approve in Sara.

approveIn.message: Approve it in Sara: Settings → Connections → Devices and sign-in, or on the page below.

pairFailed.message: The code was not approved in time. Try again.

permissionDenied.message: The browser needs your permission to reach Sara’s address.

badServer.message: Type a web address, like https://sara.example.com.

offHereNote.message: Sara is off on this site: nothing from it is sent. Untick the box to use her here.

notWebPage.message: This is not a web page Sara can read.

privateLocal.message: Private local mode is on in Sara: the extension waits until it is off.

extOff.message: The browser extension is turned off in Sara’s Settings.

askPlaceholder.message: Ask about this page (or leave empty)

waitingApproval.message: She is waiting for your OK in Sara:

readFailed.message: This page can’t be read by extensions (a browser or store page).

fillHow.message: From My details in Sara. Untick or change any field; nothing is typed until you approve, and the form is never sent.

fillSkipped.message: You type these yourself (Sara never fills passwords, cards or codes): $1

fillNone.message: No form fields found on this page.

fillNoMatch.message: None of these fields match your details.

noDetails.message: Add your details in Sara first: Settings → You → My details.

filled.message: Filled $1 fields. Check them, then send the form yourself.

revoked.message: Sara no longer knows this browser (it was disconnected in Devices). Connect it again.

cantReach.message: Sara can’t be reached right now. Check her address and your connection.

menuSave.message: Save this page to Sara’s Library
